name: EDC Book
summary: An offline e-reader with flexible typography, Chinese vertical typesetting, and touch controls for reTerminal Sticky.
description: Read DRM-free TXT, EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, and FB2 books from a microSD card. EDC Book offers configurable fonts and layout, Chinese vertical typesetting, bookmarks, and saved reading progress. Reading works offline; Wi-Fi provides optional file management and configuration. This is a closed-source firmware distributed publicly with permission to use and redistribute the binary freely.

compatibility.notes: Tested on a physical reTerminal Sticky (ESP32-S3); hardware revision was not reported. This package uses a 16 MiB flash layout. A microSD card is used for books. USB supports firmware installation, not USB mass-storage file transfer.

assets.previewAlt: EDC Book running on a physical reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Connect and install
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge. Install the complete image at offset 0x0. Back up settings before installation: this full image replaces the internal firmware, fonts, and filesystem.

notes.title: Prepare your books
notes.description: Copy DRM-free books to a microSD card using a card reader, insert it into Sticky, and open a book from the file browser. Wi-Fi file management is also available. Sticky does not expose a USB mass-storage drive.

notes.title: Firmware license
notes.description: The firmware binary is public and may be used and redistributed freely. Source code is not provided. Third-party components remain covered by their respective licenses. See LICENSE.txt in the Registry entry.
